newsitem.title: UK: Bradford wool market unmoved by firmer raw wool.
newsitem.headline: Bradford wool market unmoved by firmer raw wool.

text.p: The Bradford wool market was unmoved by firmer values for raw wool at the major auctions last week and most prices were unchanged, trade sources said on Monday.
The marginal improvement in prices for finer tops were a straightforward response to exchange rate movements and did not signify any increase in demand, they said.

Despite signs of growing confidence in the UK raw wool market with increasing numbers of buyers contracting ahead, the home tops market is still suffering from a lack of direction and remains dominated by last minute purchasing, sources said.
UK companies reported keen interest from potential buyers at the recent trade fairs in Europe although the market has yet to see any pick-up in orders as a result, they added.
But brokers said trading conditions in the UK continue to be more buoyant than in Germany, France and Italy. --London Newsroom, +44 171 542 8071
